title: Utillian 621 Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The Utillian 621 is an improved version of the popular Utillian 620 vaporizer. It has some new features like a USB-C port, a convection helix and a Wax Canister included. This model is great because it can handle both dry herbs and concentrates with ease. It’s very easy to use with its digital display and precise temperature control. The battery charges quickly from 0% to 100% in just 90 minutes and lasts a whole day of use for most average users.

The effective convection heating element paired with the adjustable shut-off timer and temperature control allows for ample extraction. Reducing the natural degradation of herb and helping preserve flower while maintaining great flavor via a precise vapor path.

Some key features of this vaporizer that you might not find in another product are an easy-to-read digital display, precise temperature control offering easy use, and 60-minute battery life makes this device essential in any vapor enthusiast’s kit.

Key Features:
2300 mAh
USB-C Charging
Digital Display
Convection Heating
Updated Mouthpiece
Magnetic Stirring Tool
Included Wax Canister
Precise Temperature Control

Specs:
Manufacturer Utillian
Battery 2300mah
Battery Life 60 Minute
Heat time 40 Seconds
Heating Style Convection
Temperature 160C° – 220C° (320 – 428°F)
Warranty 1 Year

Included in the Box:
Utillian 621
USB Cable
Screen Set
Wax Canister
Airpath Cleaning Brush
Chamber Cleaning Brush
